question: Does producer-mediated event-triggered global geometry reconstruction and directly funded packet transduction create a bounded non-tied order effect beyond a full-drain composition null, with the external orchestrator remaining the identified missing ownership layer?

fixture.direct_funding_domain: sum of trigger-owned generated packet amounts must not exceed current trigger-node coherence plus tolerance

histories.H12: left contribution arrives at t=1; right contribution arrives at t=3
histories.H21: right contribution arrives at t=1; left contribution arrives at t=3
histories.F12: left then right at the same t=1 frontier, batched before one proposal
histories.F21: right then left at the same t=1 frontier, batched before one proposal

policies.c0_full_drain: drain both exogenous packet lifecycles, reconstruct once, packetize trigger-node-owned outward current once, then fully drain
policies.c1_interleaving: after each committed exogenous arrival and its local update, reconstruct once at the completed causal frontier and packetize trigger-node-owned outward current
policies.trigger_scope: committed exogenous packet arrival and local update at node 0
policies.read_scope: fixed connected three-node dependency closure available at the completed frontier
policies.action_scope: outward current owned by trigger node 0 only
policies.packetization_rule: amount = integration_amount * abs(flux_uv); sign selects physical direction
policies.funding_failure: reject complete proposal before scheduling; no scaling, borrowing, or partial schedule
policies.independent_later_effect: fresh post-drain GRC reconstruction over final committed LGRC coherence, recording potential, flux, sink set, and choice state; active proposal current and route score are not consumed

outcome_classes.C0-EQUIV: full-drain histories are equivalent and the one-checkpoint transduction is stable
outcome_classes.C0-DOMAIN: full-drain result is bounded by a declared direct-funding domain
outcome_classes.C0-DRIFT: repeated full-drain composition drifts beyond tolerance
outcome_classes.C0-ORDER: full-drain result depends on legal history order
outcome_classes.C0-RUNTIME: current runtime cannot express the registered C0 composition
outcome_classes.C0-INVALID: source, freeze, execution, or evidence integrity fails
outcome_classes.C1-ORDER: non-tied histories differ beyond C0 and all registered controls pass
outcome_classes.C1-NULL: non-tied histories remain equivalent beyond tolerance
outcome_classes.C1-TIE: apparent effect is explained by same-frontier scheduler order
outcome_classes.C1-PROPOSAL: effect is proposal-only or self-proved by active proposal current
outcome_classes.C1-PACKET: effect is not dependent on packet transduction
outcome_classes.C1-FUNDING: positive path leaves the direct-funding domain
outcome_classes.C1-SCOPE: effect requires action outside trigger ownership or future/hidden reads
outcome_classes.C1-RUNTIME: current runtime cannot express the registered producer-mediated probe
outcome_classes.C1-INVALID: source, freeze, execution, or evidence integrity fails

maximum_claim: Source-current producer-mediated C0/C1 evidence may justify a separate owner decision about naturalizing the external event-local geometry orchestrator. It is not native event-local geometry integration or Phase 8 implementation evidence.
qualified_identifier_rule: C2 means event-local geometry integration C2 and must not be conflated with N31 Candidate C.2
